name: Jiyugaoka
tagline: Shibuya in 15 minutes and Roppongi in 24 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Meguro City, served by Tokyu Toyoko Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 39 minutes to Otemachi, 25 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 26 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 23.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.6 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 23.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 23.7 m to 37.3 m, a difference of 13.6 m. These figures were read from the elevation API of the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan at nine points: the station itself and eight compass directions 400 m out.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: 成城石井 自由が丘店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 13 clinics and 13 pharmacies. Facilities recorded as hospitals lie at 奥沢病院, about 395 m away and おくさわ脳卒中リハビリテーション病院, about 558 m away. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Tokyu Toyoko Line and Tokyu Oimachi Line. Both lines are run by Tokyu, so a fault affecting that company can stop them together. Scored out of 100 from the number of lines and the spread of operators, transfer convenience here comes to 52.

rentRange.note: One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000, 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.note: 494 m away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Jiyugaoka.
723 m away in a straight line. It takes 5 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Jiyugaoka.

goodFor: People who want to finish their shopping on foot
notFor: People avoiding projected flood inundation areas
noiseSources: The nearest main road is 自由通り, 204 m away, so little traffic noise reaches the station area

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 13 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, very few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station. The choice of connections is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: 自由通り runs 204 m away, so whether a flat faces it changes what you hear indoors.
